title: Balanced Marrakesh Lentils
subtitle: with Baby Broccoli and Wholegrains
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

steps.text: Cook grain blend: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Halve the baby broccoli lengthwise. Add the grain blend to the pan of boiling water and cook for 22-24 mins until tender, adding the baby broccoli for the last 2 mins of cooking. Drain.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, peel the sweet potato, then cut into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Finely grate the zest of half the lemon, then cut the half into wedges. Drain and rinse the lentils.
Cook spices: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Add the garlic and Moroccan seasoning and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer sweet potato: Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, 1 tbs tomato paste, ½ tsp sugar and 180ml (¾ cup) water to the pan and stir to combine. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium, cover and cook for 15 mins or until the sweet potato is tender. Stir in the lentils and cook for 1 min or until warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the grain blend, baby broccoli and lentils among bowls, scatter over the lemon zest and serve with the lemon wedges to squeeze over. Enjoy!

Did you know?: Our grain blend contains black barley, a highly nutritious grain with a nutty, slightly sweet flavour and chewy texture. It is the only grain that can go from field to fork without any processing.
